property_summary: Only the jojoTeam address can successfully call newEmergencyOracle — calls from other addresses must revert and calls from jojoTeam must emit NewEmergencyOracle and create an EmergencyOracle whose owner equals the caller and whose description matches the input.

When newEmergencyOracle is called by jojoTeam (i.e. c.jojoTeam == address(this)) it must not revert, and when it is called by any other address it must revert (authorization vs jojoTeam), so reverted == (c.jojoTeam() != address(this)).

If newEmergencyOracle call succeeds (does not revert) then it emits NewEmergencyOracle and the created EmergencyOracle's description equals the passed description and its owner equals the caller (address(this)).
